This activity is suspicious because both transactions originated from a rare device profile, SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080, behind an anonymous proxy. This specific device profile is marked as new for the account and is shared by 44 different customers. Other connected cards sharing this profile include C04311-K1, C11082-K1, C09354-K1, C12574-K1, C01996-K2, C09733-K1, C11670-K2, and C03528-K1. The activity matches an undocumented pattern of coordinated abuse, as evidenced by four previously confirmed fraud cases CC-2649, CC-2971, CC-2985, and CC-3035 involving the same device. Despite a low risk score of 0.05 for transaction 3478561, the high probability of fraud is 0.941.
